title.zh: 商品图片篡改检测服务

descriptions.zh: 传入电商商品图片，执行图片篡改、质量（清晰度）及相似图检测，返回风险标签及风险分值。
descriptions.en: Submits an e-commerce product image to perform tampering detection, quality (clarity) assessment, and similar image detection. Returns risk labels and risk scores.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudauth credential-product-verify-v2 --cred-type 05 --cred-name 0501 --image-url https://aliyundoc.com/picture00000.jpeg --image-file https://aliyundoc.com/picture00000.jpeg --merchant-id '无。' --product-code ANTI_FAKE_CHECK --api-version 2019-03-07 --region cn-hangzhou
